$comment: G1 historical simulation and replay modes vectors (FR-DATA-008 §13.6, AC-241, AC-247). Excludes retrospective data in REALIZABLE_REPLAY mode; distinguishes ORACLE, HINDSIGHT, COUNTERFACTUAL_DATA_AVAILABILITY_RESEARCH.

modes.description: Strict point-in-time replay: excludes any retrospective/backfilled data whose actual availability postdates boundary T
Simulation mode with perfect forward information access for benchmark ceilings
Diagnostic evaluation using full retrospective data known after the fact
Research mode modeling hypothetical earlier or later data availability under controlled counterfactual timelines

replayVectors.name: realizable replay at 12:00 excludes backfill available at 14:30 even though event occurred at 10:00
realizable replay at 15:00 includes backfill available at 14:30
hindsight diagnostic mode allows viewing retrospective backfill before its availability timestamp
